_README: Shipped model pricing — the source of truth for spend-ledger accounting.
Rates are USD per MILLION tokens, as published on Anthropic's pricing page.
Only 'input' and 'output' are stored. The two cache rates are derived from input by a
multiplier, because that is how the pricing page presents them: cache write is 1.25x input
(5-minute TTL — the 1h column is a different product we don't use) and cache read is 0.1x.
That 0.1x is standard but NOT universal, so a model may override 'cache_read_mult' — see
Fable/Mythos 5.1, whose 0.025x lives in a page FOOTNOTE rather than a column. Deriving it
blindly priced those two 4x high on every cached call, which is why the live drift check
compares the cache columns too instead of assuming.
PRICES ARE TEMPORAL. A model maps to either one rate object (shorthand for 'this price, for
all time') or a LIST of periods, each optionally carrying 'effective_start' and
'effective_until' as 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' (UTC). Periods are half-open
[start, until), so one ending on 2026-09-23 and the next starting on 2026-09-23 do not
overlap. Overlaps are fatal (the rate at an instant would be ambiguous) and so are gaps (it
would be unknown, and inventing a neighbouring period's number is worse than refusing).
This is what makes a mispriced ledger repairable: spend_ledger rows store tokens, so
reprice.py recomputes each row at the rate effective at ITS OWN timestamp. When a price
changes, close the old period and add the new one with the real effective date from the
announcement, then run ./reprice.sh. Don't reconstruct effective dates from this file's git
history — that records when WE learned something, not when a price changed, and backfilling
from it would stamp our old mistakes as authoritative-for-their-era.
tests/test_pricing_live.py diffs this file against the live pricing page and FAILS on a real
mismatch, so it cannot quietly go stale. To add a model before we ship it here, don't edit
this file — create model_pricing.local.json (gitignored) with the same shape; it merges over
this one per model, replacing that model's ENTIRE timeline. See docs/configuration.md.

claude-fable-5-1.note: The .1 refresh keeps Fable 5's base rates but cuts cache hits to 0.025x input.

claude-mythos-5-1.note: Project Glasswing only; the twin of Fable 5.1, same specs and price.

claude-mythos-5.note: Project Glasswing only; same specs/price as Fable 5.

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: Launched 2026-09-29 at the same headline rates as Sonnet 5 (the 'up to 30% cheaper per task' claim is about tokens used at Medium effort, not the per-token price). A point release, not a snapshot, so it needs its own entry — it must never inherit Sonnet 5's.

claude-sonnet-5.note: The launch 'introductory' $2/$10 is now the permanent standard price: Anthropic cancelled the increase to $3/$15 that had been scheduled for 2026-09-01.
